What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based platform that allows developers to automate tasks and workflows, including digital commerce automation, without requiring any prior programming knowledge. It's a game-changer for digital creators in restricted regions, like Zimbabwe, who need to automate their order fulfillment and delivery processes. By integrating Google Apps Script with NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway, and Cloudflare Workers, a serverless platform, digital creators can create a seamless, automated digital commerce experience for their customers, regardless of the payment method or location.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation consists of several components that work together to process orders, send download links, and update order status in real-time. When a customer makes a payment using NOWPayments, the payment data is sent to Cloudflare Workers, which triggers a webhook event that notifies the Google Apps Script backend. The script then updates the order status, sends a download link to the customer, and stores the order details in a Supabase database. This entire process happens in under 30 seconds, ensuring that customers receive their digital products instantly after payment confirmation.

Supabase stores the order details, and Cloudflare Pages hosts the digital products. Together, these components create a seamless, automated digital commerce experience for customers.
